<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 233.9632. Interpreting this as the protonated molecular ion ([M+H]⁺) gives a neutral mass of ≈ 232.956 Da. A formula that matches this mass within typical high‑resolution error is C₁₂H₁₂O₄N.</thought>
<final_answer>C12H12O4N</final_answer>
